issues.reason: Bare 'when P, Q' with indefinite participants routes to 'exactly the whenever machinery', whose response Skolem event is 'tied to its trigger with During' — the parse emits no link at all between (sk_accumulate $x) and the hunt event $e.

The response is 'a Skolem event per occurrence' keyed on the trigger, and each dependent existential is 'a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it' — (sk_accumulate $x) / (sk_feathers $x) ignore the hunt $e, so all of one cat's summer hunts collapse into a single accumulation and a single feather group.

gaps_confirmed: temporal-extent preposition over a named period ('hunts through summer'): During is restricted to during/while/throughout, a season has no structured or reified form, and a bare (Time $e summer) records the slot but drops the extent
new_gaps: a bare season name as a bound term ('by autumn' → (TimeAtMost e autumn)): bound terms accept calendar terms, day-part constants and fiscal periods; a season constant is unlisted
'many' counting things ('many feathers'): 'many' appears only in the proportion-to-strength list, not in the CardinalityPhrase vague-count list, so its canonical lexicon string is unconfirmed
defect_summary: Key the response on the trigger and tie it — (GroupOf (sk_feathers $e) feather) (CardinalityPhrase (sk_feathers $e) "many") (Member (sk_accumulate $e) accumulate) (Theme (sk_accumulate $e) (sk_feathers $e)) (Location (sk_accumulate $e) sk_base_1) (TimeAtMost (sk_accumulate $e) autumn) plus (During (sk_accumulate $e) $e); the top-level cliff/base typing with PartOf, the sky_cat genus and the tenseless rule at 1.0 0.9 otherwise stand.
notes: Theme for the non-volitionally accumulating feathers is defensible under the un-powered-relocation line.
